title: API: an untracked part created with stock and a cost writes the same inventory change and accounting row
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com, S2 shop. Location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. API replay from Chrome DevTools against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com with header X-Location-ID = the current location (Copy as fetch from a request of the logged-in session, then edit method, path and body). Category = the category of QAPL-T1 (no COGS override). Pick Category before typing Cost (typing Cost first gives a pre-existing 400 "Invalid UUID", not a defect). No DB access: the inventory change is compared through Part History; the accounting outbox row is DB-only.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Inventory Part and create QA-ACC-TR-1 / QA ACC tracked: Category, Cost 1.50, default bin quantity 4, tracking switch left on; Save. Copy the POST /api/inventory/parts/create request from the Network tab.
  2. Replay the copied request with only partNumber QA-ACC-UN-1, description QA ACC untracked and "isTracked":false changed.
  3. Search QA-ACC on the Active tab.
  4. Open the Part History of both parts and compare the entries that record the initial stock.
  5. Compare the accounting side of both creates in the accounting system connected to the S2 shop (if any).
custom_expected:
1. 201 with "isTracked":true; the part is created.
  2. 201 with "isTracked":false.
  3. QA-ACC-TR-1 shows "4 available"; QA-ACC-UN-1 shows Not Tracked in Total Qty and its bin chip shows the default bin with quantity 4.
  4. Both parts have the same initial stock entry (same event, quantity 4, cost 1.50, same bin); nothing is missing or extra on the untracked part (no DB access: this stands in for the DB check of the inventory change row).
  5. Both creates post the same way (same amount, same type). If the S2 shop has no accounting connection, mark this sub-check dev-verified (the outbox row is DB-only) and attach steps 1–4 as evidence.
